meta.title: The Abeng Law Firm | Business Law in Douala, Cameroon
meta.description: The Abeng Law Firm is a Douala-based business law firm founded in 1998, advising on OHADA, corporate, banking and cross-border matters across Central Africa.

hero.title: Business law, built on OHADA discipline.
hero.subtitle: The Abeng Law Firm advises Cameroonian and international clients on corporate, commercial and cross-border matters, from Bonapriso, Douala.

intro.title: A firm built on civil-law discipline
intro.body: Founded in 1998 by Barrister Abeng Roland, The Abeng Law Firm advises businesses operating in and with Cameroon on the full range of OHADA and domestic legal matters, from company formation and financing to disputes and regulatory compliance.

pillars.title: Corporate & OHADA Law
pillars.body: Advice grounded in the OHADA Uniform Acts that govern business across seventeen West and Central African member states.

pillars.title: Cross-border reach
pillars.body: An international network through Chambers-ranked recognition and membership of TagLaw and TRACE.

pillars.title: Sector depth
pillars.body: Matters spanning energy, banking, telecommunications, maritime and other pillars of the Cameroonian economy.

peopleTeaser.title: Led by Barrister Abeng Roland
peopleTeaser.body: The Firm's Managing Partner has built The Abeng Law Firm's practice and its network of international relationships since 1998.

cta.title: Discuss a matter with the Firm
cta.body: For new instructions or general enquiries, reach the Firm directly by telephone or through the contact form.
